title: Termwise extension-by-zero short exact complexes for a two-open etale cover
statement: Let Λ be a commutative ring, X a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and U,V opens covering X, with W=U∩V. For a cochain complex L of Λ-module sheaves, put E(T)(L)=jT! applied termwise after jT* [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero] [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. There exist complex maps α:E(W)(L)→E(U)(L)⊕E(V)(L) and β:E(U)(L)⊕E(V)(L)→L, with α≫β=0, for which the resulting short complex is short exact [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence].

proof.text: Take the natural nested-open maps from [lem-weil-pbc-etale-open-cover-shriek-natural-ses] degreewise, and the complex adjunction counits. Naturality makes the first two families into complex maps. Their signed pair has zero composite because the sheaf-level composite vanishes in every degree.

Apply degreewise short exactness of complexes. Evaluation preserves biproducts; its comparison identifies the evaluated signed pair and counit pair with the sheaf-level short exact sequence. Transport along that comparison and use HomologicalComplex.shortExact_of_degreewise_shortExact.

theorem exists_shortExact_openCover_lowerShriek_complex
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (U V : X.Opens) (hcover : U ⊔ V = ⊤)
    (L : CochainComplex (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) ℤ) :
    let E (T : X.Opens) :=
      ((openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) T.ι).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
        (((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) T.ι).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj L)
    ∃ (α : E (U ⊓ V) ⟶ E U ⊞ E V) (β : E U ⊞ E V ⟶ L) (hz : α ≫ β = 0),
      (ShortComplex.mk α β hz).ShortExact
